product_metadata.title: JoyJolt Drinking Glasses Set of 8, Alina Ribbed Glassware. 12oz Rocks Glasses and 14oz Highball Glasses. Cocktail Glasses, Iced Coffee Cup or Water Glasses. Premium Art Deco Heavy Base Glassware Set
features: RIPPLED GLASSWARE FOR RITZY DRINKS: This drinkware set of 8 ribbed glasses features a thick fluted glassware texture that’s satisfying to hold, while holding your drinks. From mojito glass to tom collins glasses… beer glass to dinner glasses, this modern glassware is ritzy, and rippled for joy!

8 EVERYDAY DRINKING GLASSES: 4x tall glasses are 5.7” tall, 3.1” wide / 14oz. 4x DoF Glasses – 3.75” tall, 3.4” wide / 12oz. Whether they’re destined to become tall whiskey glasses or small juice glasses; the grip, thick rim, half inch base, and solid glass makes this vintage drinkware feel toast-worthy.

LEAD-FREE RIPPLE GLASSWARE: Our mixed drinkware sets are handmade from durable soda lime glass. And while they look like vintage drinking glasses, they’re completely lead-free. Our low and high ball tumbler glasses are extra strong and dishwasher safe, plus fridge and freezer safe.

IMPRESSIVE ‘CUT CRYSTAL’ LOOK: Our amazing hand-debossing technology gives the illusion of cut crystal drinking glasses, but without the tackiness of flat-on-the-outside clear drinking glasses. There’s no unevenness, just the same lines and shine seen in tall glasses and small cups found in a boutique

DRINK WITH JOY: Your textured drinking glasses are mouth-blown hand-pressed, and come individually wrapped, separated, and nestled in a drop-tested gift box with a 12 Month Guarantee for a successful unboxing. Surprise someone you love with a dazzling modern vintage glassware by JoyJolt.
